title: slugify leaves double dashes in URLs
body:
Product URLs look broken for names with punctuation.

`slugify("Blue T-Shirt (Large)")` returns `blue-t-shirt--large` but it should be `blue-t-shirt-large`. Any run of spaces or symbols should become a single dash.

title: truncate returns text longer than the limit
body: We use `truncate` to fit product titles into a 10-character label, but `truncate("Wireless headphones", 10)` gives `Wireless h...`, which is 13 characters. The result including the `...` should never be longer than the limit.

title: Prices with single-digit cents display wrong
body: The checkout page shows `$12.5` for an item that costs $12.05. `format_price(1205)` should return `$12.05`. Whole-dollar prices are wrong too: `format_price(100)` gives `$1.0` instead of `$1.00`.

title: Discount over 100% makes the price negative
body: A misconfigured promotion gave a 150% discount and the cart showed a negative total. `apply_discount(1000, 150)` returns `-500`. A price should never go below 0.

title: Adding the same item twice loses the first quantity
body:
Steps:
1. `cart.add("apple", 50, quantity=2)`
2. `cart.add("apple", 50, quantity=3)`

Expected 5 apples in the cart, but there are only 3.

title: Bulk discount not applied at exactly 10 items
body: The docs say carts with 10 items or more get 10% off. A cart with exactly 10 pens at $1.00 totals $10.00 instead of $9.00. It works with 11 items.

title: Saturday is treated as a working day
body: Orders placed on Friday with 1-day delivery are promised for Saturday, but the warehouse is closed at weekends. `is_weekend(date(2026, 10, 31))` returns False even though Oct 31 2026 is a Saturday.

title: median is wrong for an even number of values
body: `median([1, 2, 3, 4])` returns 3. For an even count it should be the mean of the two middle values, so 2.5.

title: Product descriptions keep tabs and line breaks
body:
Descriptions pasted from a spreadsheet still contain tabs and newlines after cleaning.

`normalize_whitespace("Soft\tcotton\n\nshirt")` returns the text unchanged, but it should be `Soft cotton shirt`. Any mix of spaces, tabs and newlines should become one space.

title: Prices with a thousands separator crash the import
body:
Importing our price list fails on expensive items:

```
>>> parse_price("$1,234.56")
ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: '1,234'
```

It should return `123456`. Prices without a comma, like `parse_price("12.5")`, work fine.

title: Splitting a bill loses a cent
body: When three friends split a $10.00 order, `split_evenly(1000, 3)` gives `[333, 333, 333]`, which only adds up to $9.99. The shares must always add up to the full amount, for example `[334, 333, 333]`.

title: Invoice dates are read with day and month swapped
body: Our invoices write dates day first. `parse_date("31/10/2026")` raises `ValueError: month must be in 1..12`, and `parse_date("05/11/2026")` returns 11 May instead of 5 November.

title: Sales growth percentage is wrong
body: The report says sales grew 33.3% when they went from 100 to 150 units. `percent_change(100, 150)` should be `50.0`, and `percent_change(200, 100)` should be `-50.0`.

title: Best sellers list shows the worst sellers
body:
The "Top 3 products" widget shows our slowest items.

`top_n({"mug": 5, "pen": 40, "cap": 12, "bag": 1}, 2)` returns `['bag', 'mug']` but should return `['pen', 'cap']`.

title: Stock goes negative when an order is bigger than the stock
body: We had 2 lamps in stock and a customer ordered 5. `inventory.reserve("lamp", 5)` succeeded and the stock is now -3. It should raise `OutOfStockError` and leave the stock at 2.

title: Low-stock report misses items exactly at the threshold
body: The reorder report should list items with 5 or fewer left. An item with exactly 5 in stock is missing from `inventory.low_stock(5)`. Items with 4 are listed.

title: Every order gets free shipping
body: Free shipping is supposed to start at $50, but a $5 order with a 300 g parcel also ships free. `shipping_for_order(500, 300)` returns `0` instead of `499`.

title: Removing an item that is not in the cart crashes
body: If a customer clicks "remove" twice, the second click crashes the page with `KeyError: 'mug'`. `cart.remove("mug")` on a cart without a mug should just do nothing.
